target.title: fix(ai): preserve compat xhigh reasoning effort
target.body:
<!-- submission-timestamps:start -->
First submitted: July 19, 2026, 6:22 AM (US Eastern Time) / 10:22 UTC.
Last body edit: July 19, 2026, 6:38 AM (US Eastern Time) / 10:38 UTC.
Latest head commit: July 19, 2026, 6:34 AM (US Eastern Time) / 10:34 UTC.
<!-- submission-timestamps:end -->

## Summary

This contribution preserves an explicitly supported `xhigh` reasoning effort for OpenAI-compatible models instead of clamping it to `high` before the OpenAI Responses request is built.

The change is a clean current-main rebase of the work originally developed in [#90703](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90703). Credit and thanks to @Alex-Govorov for the original implementation, investigation, and regression coverage.

## What Problem This Solves

The session layer can persist `xhigh` and report that the highest thinking depth is selected. However, the model capability calculation did not consult `compat.supportedReasoningEfforts` when `thinkingLevelMap.xhigh` was absent. The request therefore entered the Responses transport as `high` even when the configured compatible provider explicitly declared `xhigh` support.

The provider dashboard was accurately showing `high`: OpenClaw had already sent `high`; the provider was not performing a second downgrade.

## Why This Change Was Made

The model catalog's compatibility contract is the owner of provider-specific reasoning support. Transport adapters should serialize the resolved supported effort, while unsupported levels must remain hidden or be clamped conservatively.

This contribution makes that contract explicit for both capability discovery and payload construction. It does not broaden support for models that do not declare the effort.

## User Impact

Configured OpenAI-compatible models that declare `xhigh` in `compat.supportedReasoningEfforts` can retain `xhigh` through the Responses and Completions request paths. Models without explicit compatible support continue to be capped at their declared native capability.

## Implementation

- Extend the shared model compatibility contract with normalized supported reasoning efforts and optional effort mappings.
- Consult compatibility metadata when exposing extended thinking levels.
- Require mapped efforts to be supported before treating `xhigh` or `max` as available.
- Resolve mapped reasoning efforts in OpenAI Completions and Responses payloads.
- Preserve conservative handling for explicit provider opt-outs and the `max` alias.
- Add regression tests for capability discovery, clamping, Completions payloads, and Responses payloads.

## Code-Path Analysis

- Changed surface: `packages/ai/src/model-utils.ts`, OpenAI Completions and Responses adapters, shared LLM types, model configuration types, model registry metadata, and focused tests.
- Runtime entry: model configuration is resolved into a `Model`, then `getSupportedThinkingLevels` and `clampThinkingLevel` determine the effective thinking level before provider request construction.
- Owner: model compatibility metadata owns the supported-effort contract; the provider adapters own serialization.
- Callers: the agent model-selection/session path and the OpenAI Completions/Responses stream builders.
- Callees: `clampThinkingLevel`, `resolveOpenAIReasoningEffortForModel`, `resolveResponsesApiReasoningEffort`, and the provider request builders.
- Sibling implementation: the OpenAI Completions and Responses adapters now use the same compatibility contract while retaining transport-specific request shapes.
- Tests: `src/llm/model-utils.test.ts`, `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.test.ts`, and `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-responses-shared.test.ts`.

## Mainline Comparison

- Upstream: `OpenClaw/OpenClaw:main`
- Base commit: `b9c9140034d7c118a3249def12f29e00e69df849`
- Base commit time: July 19, 2026, 3:31 AM (US Eastern Time) / 07:31 UTC.
- The dedicated branch was rebased onto this upstream HEAD before push.
- Current upstream main was checked for changes to the affected model and provider surfaces before submission.

## Branch and Base Provenance

- Base: `OpenClaw/OpenClaw:main@b9c9140034d7c118a3249def12f29e00e69df849`
- Head: `snowzlmbot/OpenClaw:fix/openai-xhigh-supported-efforts@6fd514e37d68bbe69db73e8ee4170707ddb98d6f`
- The fork default branch was not used for development and was not modified by this work.
- This branch contains only the six original #90703 commits, replayed onto current upstream main with the original author preserved.

## Dependency and Contract Verification

This fix uses the repository's model compatibility types and OpenAI adapter contracts. No dependency version change is required for this behavior. The provider-specific effort list remains metadata-driven, and unknown or unsupported effort values are not promoted into the request.

## Validation

- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- The branch was rebased cleanly onto upstream `main` at `b9c9140034d7c118a3249def12f29e00e69df849`.
- Focused regression tests are included in the same change.
- Full build and test execution is intentionally delegated to GitHub Actions for this contribution; no local build artifact is used as evidence.

## Evidence Source Map

- Original real-behavior evidence and sanitized runtime observation: [#90703 evidence comment](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90703#issuecomment-5015182424).
- The original report established that the session retained `xhigh` while the outbound Responses request was `high`; this clean branch carries the corresponding owner-boundary fix and regression tests onto current upstream main.
- Current-head CI checks are the authoritative validation for this clean branch after the PR is opened.

## Sanitized Logs

Observed behavior before the fix, with provider and account details removed:

```text
session thinking level: xhigh
outbound Responses reasoning effort: high
provider dashboard reasoning effort: high
```

Expected behavior after the fix:

```text
session thinking level: xhigh
outbound Responses reasoning effort: xhigh
```

## Media Evidence

This is a non-UI provider/runtime change. Screenshots and video are not applicable; the behavior is demonstrated by the sanitized request observation and focused regression tests.

## Risk

The main compatibility risk is exposing an effort that a provider does not actually accept. The implementation avoids that risk by requiring explicit compatible support and by preserving conservative fallback behavior. The transport risk is limited to OpenAI-compatible Completions and Responses reasoning fields.

## Rollback

Revert the six commits on this branch. No configuration migration, data migration, dependency migration, or irreversible operation is introduced.

## Docs Updated

No documentation or changelog change is required for this internal runtime correction. The repository contribution guide reserves changelog updates for maintainers.

## Related Issue and PR

- Related prior contribution: [#90703](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90703)
- Original contributor: @Alex-Govorov

## Labels Considered

`bug`, `regression`, and `area:ai` may be appropriate; no labels are being applied by this contributor.

## Not Tested / Limitations

- Full repository build and test matrix has not been run locally.
- Current-head GitHub Actions validation for `6fd514e37d68bbe69db73e8ee4170707ddb98d6f`: 70 checks completed with 0 failures. The [Real behavior proof job](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29683638678/job/88184097455) completed successfully; [actionlint](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29683600768/job/88183994628) and [no-tabs](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29683600768/job/88183994641) also passed.
- The public evidence link above documents the original reproduced behavior; the clean current-main branch carries the regression coverage and the current-head checks passed.

## AI-Assisted Contribution

This PR was prepared with AI assistance. The contributor has reviewed the code path, the compatibility contract, the focused tests, and the rebase onto current upstream main.
